slot.brief: Diagram of a particle at a point with position and velocity vectors marked; ask for the angular momentum of the particle about the origin using r × mv.

stem: A particle of mass 2 kg is at a point P with position vector r = 3i + 2j + k m from the origin O and has velocity v = i - j + 2k m/s, as shown in the figure. The angular momentum of the particle about O is

verdicts.working: \(\mathbf L=\mathbf r\times m\mathbf v=2[(2\cdot2-1\cdot(-1))\hat i+(1\cdot1-3\cdot2)\hat j+(3\cdot(-1)-2\cdot1)\hat k]=10\hat i-10\hat j-10\hat k\).

working:
p = m*v = 2*(i - j + 2k) = 2i - 2j + 4k kg m/s. L = r x p = i*(2*4 - 1*(-2)) - j*(3*4 - 1*2) + k*(3*(-2) - 2*2) = 10i - 10j - 10k kg m^2/s.

Independent check: \(\mathbf L=\mathbf r\times m\mathbf v=2[(2\cdot2-1\cdot(-1))\hat i+(1\cdot1-3\cdot2)\hat j+(3\cdot(-1)-2\cdot1)\hat k]=10\hat i-10\hat j-10\hat k\).
solution:
Angular momentum is $[0m\mathbf L=\mathbf r\times\mathbf p$, where $\mathbf p=m\mathbf v=2\hat i-2\hat j+4\hat k$.
$$\mathbf L=(3\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k)\times(2\hat i-2\hat j+4\hat k)=10\hat i-10\hat j-10\hat k\;\text{kg m}^2\!\!/\text{s}$$

figure.description: A Cartesian coordinate system with origin O and mutually perpendicular x, y and z axes. A point P is drawn at coordinates (3, 2, 1) and labelled P. Draw a solid arrow from O to P labelled r = 3i + 2j + k m. From point P, draw a separate arrow labelled v = i - j + 2k m/s. Write m = 2 kg next to point P. Do not show any angular momentum vector or answer.
